slides.title: Causative have / get something done
slides.subtitle: When someone else does it for you
goals: Talk about services: haircuts, repairs, deliveries.

head: Structure
Example
rows: I need to **get my car fixed**.
We're **having the house painted**. I'll **get it delivered**.

errors.bad: I cut my hair at the barber.
errors.good: I **had my hair cut** at the barber.
errors.note: If someone else did it, use the causative.

items.t: My phone screen broke. I need to get it ___ (repair).
She had her nails ___ (do) for the wedding.
We're having our kitchen ___ (paint) next week.

options: Did you have your hair cut?

items.q: I got my eyes ___ last week.
